source.citation: Leichty AR, Brisson D (2014) Selective whole genome amplification for resequencing target microbial species from complex natural samples. Genetics 198(2):473-481.
source.tables: Table S1 (primer sequences); Tables 1-2 and Results for outcomes
source.notes: The original SWGA paper. Primers were selected by a PERL script on target/background k-mer frequency ratio with a Tm cutoff, before the swga toolkit existed - so evenness was never a design criterion here. SR2 is the two least-permissive primers of SR1; Clarke et al. (2017) later benchmarked SR2 as 'Leichty and Brisson 2014'.

outcome.note: Amplification of B. burgdorferi orders of magnitude greater than E. coli across 1:2 to 1:2000 starting ratios; target dominated post-SWGA.
Substantial amplification of W. pipientis with limited D. melanogaster amplification.

The two least-permissive primers of SR1. Further decreased D. melanogaster amplification; with restriction digest reached 1264-fold target vs 9-fold background (~140x selective) and up to 70% of reads on target against 2.4-8.8% unamplified.
